purpose: Resolve conflicting historical Pass 3 records and lock the complete bounded sequence required before Pass 4 may begin.
authority_precedence: This record governs the remaining work of current 13-pass roadmap Pass 3.
The 13-pass roadmap fixes the Pass 3 objective but did not define internal units; this record supplies those bounded units without changing the roadmap order.
pmp-pass3-route-handoff-freeze-v1.json is preserved as historical active-path evidence only; its instruction to stop modifying Pass 3 does not close the current roadmap gap.
Modern Pass 3 Hook Validation Unit 1 and Unit 2 are preserved as historical isolated hook-validation evidence only and are not current roadmap Pass 3 units.
The Passes 1-3 completion audit remains valid evidence that the historical freeze and isolated hook proofs did not satisfy the full roadmap completion test.
PR #134 and audit/pass3/pass3-route-guardian-handoff-contract-unit1-v1.json are current roadmap Pass 3 Unit 1 truth.

units.name: Canonical handoff contract and deterministic source validation
units.scope: Contract definition, one positive case, fail-closed mutations, exact-scope verifier, and CI; no runtime activation.

units.name: Passive runtime consumer integration
units.objective: Integrate the Unit 1 contract into the smallest existing runtime consumer that already receives or executes the Route Guardian handoff, without transferring route authority or inventing destinations.
required_discovery_before_edit: Trace the live pmp-current-map-v12.json route_guardian to current_app path on verified main.
Identify the single narrowest existing consumer boundary that can validate the complete PMP_ROUTE_HANDOFF_V1 lineage before navigation.
Record the selected file and rejected alternatives in the unit audit before changing runtime bytes.
allowed_behavior: Construct or receive the canonical map-issued handoff.
Validate all Unit 1 required fields against the same loaded current map.
Continue the already-authorized current_app navigation only after validation succeeds.
Emit bounded diagnostic evidence without persisting new user state.
forbidden_behavior: Do not change Current Map destination truth.
Do not use alternate, historical, saved, hard-coded, owner, pointer, or implicit fallback destinations.
Do not rebuild banks, reorder levels, migrate storage, delete files, or begin Boot Status Strip work.
Do not claim browser or real-app proof.
units.completion: Dedicated PR merged after deterministic positive and fail-closed consumer tests, exact-scope verification, all fresh CI, resulting-main verification, installed-file verification, snapshot refresh, and additive ZIP publication.

units.name: Isolated runtime handoff proof
units.objective: Exercise the integrated consumer in an isolated runtime harness and prove valid handoffs continue while invalid, stale, incomplete, or non-map-issued handoffs fail closed without navigation.
required_cases: Every required lineage field missing fails closed.
Wrong type, role, map path, map version, route epoch, or destination fails closed.
Historical-map, hard-coded, saved-route, owner, pointer, and implicit-fallback attempts fail closed.
Rejected handoffs produce zero navigation assignments and zero persisted-user-data writes.
forbidden_behavior: Do not use the real production app as the proof harness.
Do not modify route authority or activate later Pass 3 behavior.
Do not claim live-browser or visual proof.
units.completion: Dedicated PR merged with deterministic isolated-runtime evidence, exact-scope verification, fresh CI, resulting-main and installed-file verification, snapshot refresh, and additive ZIP publication.

units.name: Bounded live current-path observation
units.objective: Observe one bounded current-path run proving Route Guardian reaches the map-issued current_app through the integrated consumer and that a deliberately invalid handoff is blocked before navigation.
required_evidence: Verified main and exact installed-file identities before observation.
Canonical Route Guardian source and current_app destination match pmp-current-map-v12.json.
App Orchestrator is observably loaded or acknowledged at the current app boundary without taking unrelated ownership.
One controlled invalid-handoff probe is blocked before navigation.
No persisted user data, bank structure, level order, Mount Registry, Section Owner, Helper, migration, or Boot Status Strip behavior changes.
units.claim_ceiling: Bounded live current-path observation only; not a certification of later passes, unrelated app behavior, or broad production correctness.
units.completion: Dedicated PR merged with bounded evidence, exact-scope verification, all fresh CI, resulting-main and installed-file verification, snapshot refresh, and additive ZIP publication.

units.name: Pass 3 closure certification
units.objective: Certify that Units 1-4 collectively satisfy the current roadmap handoff objective and establish the exact boundary for Pass 4.
required_checks: All Unit 1-4 PRs are merged and their resulting main commits remain in main history.
Current Map remains sole destination authority and resolver behavior remains fail closed.
The live Route Guardian to current_app path is verified at the bounded claim scope.
App Orchestrator presence at the handoff destination is evidenced.
No unauthorized fallback, persisted-user-data mutation, history deletion, Pass 4 work, or PR #122 change occurred.
Every installed file introduced or changed by Units 1-4 matches verified main.
The embedded repository snapshot and deterministic manifest match the verified resulting main commit.
units.pass3_completion_test: Pass 3 is complete only when the canonical Route Guardian handoff contract is integrated into the narrowest runtime consumer, deterministic isolated tests prove valid continuation and invalid fail-closed behavior, one bounded live current-path observation confirms the map-issued Route Guardian -> current_app -> App Orchestrator boundary, and a closure certification PR is merged and packaged.
units.next_after_completion: Pass 4/13 — Boot Status Strip. No Pass 4 work may occur inside the closure unit.

execution_rule: Complete exactly one remaining unit per move. A unit is not complete at draft or branch state; it requires fresh CI, exact-scope verification, merge, resulting-main verification, installed-file verification, snapshot refresh, and additive ZIP publication.
